access.note: Single-company public search is free (no account). The integration WEB SERVICE needs registration/contract. A FULL bulk for a commercial database needs a data-sharing agreement. For open bulk, prefer the CC-BY publications via data_egov_bg.

pagination.note: Per-EIK lookup. No anonymous population enumeration. The open bulk path is the CC-BY daily publications (data_egov_bg). Confirm web-service shape from the Registry Agency integration docs.

transport.rate_limit: single lookups unrestricted; bulk by agreement

snapshot.note: Either per-EIK via the web service, or build a master by accumulating data_egov_bg publications keyed on EIK.

parsing.notes: eik stays string (9 or 13 digits). Names in Cyrillic (+Latin translit). предмет на дейност free text (no КИД). управители/съдружници are PII. Capital BGN (EUR from 2026).

mapping_rules.activity: предмет на дейност (free text; no coded NACE).

fixture_requirements: ЕООД with управител + едноличен собственик + капитал

live_test_plan.smoke: Free public search by a known EIK to confirm field availability (manual). Do not mass-scrape the public search.
live_test_plan.full: Either register for the web service (per-EIK) or ingest the CC-BY publications (data_egov_bg) and accumulate to a master keyed on EIK. Full bulk only under a data-sharing agreement.

blockers: Integration web service needs registration; full bulk needs a data-sharing agreement.
No anonymous population enumeration (use the CC-BY publications for open bulk).
No coded activity (предмет на дейност free text).
